checkpoints.notes: 5 concepts brainstormed and scored (added a testability criterion this cycle, motivated by Cycle 1's untested win-condition gap). Photon Reflect (grid laser-reflection puzzle, procedurally generated + solvability-checked) selected; Orbit Duel: AI Rival kept as runner-up/fallback.

Pure-function core (simulate() beam physics, generateLevel() with backward-from-solution generation + solvability check) separated from render/input/DOM, single-file HTML5 canvas architecture (game/cycle2/index.html), test hook pattern reused from Cycle 1 (getters for reassigned refs). Testing plan explicitly targets closing Cycle 1's win-condition-not-automated gap via a scripted-solution E2E test.

followUps: Cycle 1 follow-ups still open and deferred to a future cycle: human/manual playtest of Orbit Duel for feel/balance tuning; 'Orbit Duel: AI Rival' remains a good Cycle 3 candidate.
Photon Reflect: human/manual fun-tuning of generated level difficulty is out of scope for this pass (flagged in design.md), same category of gap as Cycle 1's physics feel-tuning.
budgetNotes: Cycle 2 single-session, no subagent fan-out, consistent with Cycle 1. Research + design both completed directly in-session under the currently-running model rather than spawning a separate Opus agent for design, to conserve budget -- design doc was still written with the same rigor (explicit architecture, algorithms, and a testing plan up front).
resumeInstructions: Cycle 2 phases 'research' and 'design' are complete with valid outputs (docs/cycle2/concepts.md, docs/cycle2/design.md) -- do not re-run them. Resume at 'implementation': build game/cycle2/index.html per docs/cycle2/design.md (pure simulate()/generateLevel() core + canvas render + click input + window.__photonReflect test hook), then test per the design doc's testing plan and record results in docs/cycle2/test-results.md. Keep Cycle 1's outputs untouched for audit trail; all Cycle 2 outputs live under the cycle2/ subfolders.
